data.name: Goerke
data.long_meaning: The name Goerke is of Germanic origin and translates to 'guardian' or 'protector'. In Old Germanic, the root word 'gaira' means 'to guard' or 'to protect', while the suffix '-ke' denotes a person or guardian. This name was popular among medieval knights and warriors, who were expected to protect their lands and people.
